timing.old_barrier: All /api/harness-sessions query reads were counted, including project-tree reads. Waiting for already observed transports to settle does not wait for a retry scheduled in the future or for the refresh status update.
timing.lost_outcome: After one failure the delayed-update indicator stays visible. A later loop can satisfy its transport counter using another reader and pass the already-visible indicator assertion while the table read is still in backoff. The next online event restarts the poller and invalidates that unfinished read, so it cannot increment the failure count.
timing.clock_ownership: The Agents case uses its own real browser clock; the Live Agents case has a separate Playwright page/context. No fake-clock state is shared between cases. The competing-reader reproduction fails within one refresh sequence, without advancing the 20-second periodic timer.
